project_info.theme: Vintage-film fashion exit from a car in neon rain

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a cinematic vintage-film fashion editorial of an adult woman using the attached approved-adult face reference; preserve her face, facial structure, proportions, features, and expression exactly without celebrity or public-figure substitution. Show her mid-exit from a car in rain, with wet hair falling naturally forward and an umbrella held at a dramatic practical angle. Dress her in a dark tailored blazer-and-skirt ensemble over a fitted opaque knit top, with polished black heels. One foot steps toward a puddle while the other remains balanced near the car threshold. Frame a full-body editorial composition that gives equal visual weight to the woman, car door, umbrella, wet street, and city setting rather than isolating any body part. Add red taillights reflected in the puddle, warm car-interior glow, rain drops frozen in the air, a small splash at the stepping foot, blurred city lights, neon bokeh, and umbrella silhouettes. Use vintage 35mm styling with a moderate wide editorial perspective and slight Dutch tilt, Fujifilm Nostalgic Negative-inspired color, heavy ISO 800 pushed film grain, warm natural skin tones, cool blue-gray rain, subtle highlight halation, visible analog texture, and cinematic high-fashion impact.
